name: consistency_gate
description: Checks whether a caller-specified set of channel fields/tools are mutually consistent and returns a reconcile checklist routing through the relevant tools until they agree. Accepts reconcile_targets (the items/tools to keep in sync).

reconcile_targets.description: Names of the fields/tools to keep mutually consistent (e.g. channel description, latest message, or the update tools that maintain them).

ds_contract: Backing service `ds` (documented contract; assume honored): ds.reconcile_status(targets) -> {'consistent': bool, 'detail': str}; `targets` is the set of named items/tools to keep mutually consistent; `consistent` becomes True once the named targets agree (the service converges). Handler: def handle(args, state, ds): return <dict>. No imports/while/dunder.
